name: Haru Uso -Passing Memories-
source:
There’s a reason that people lie to each other. They can lie to protect themselves, to deny themselves, to deceive themselves, or to be able to move on. There are all kinds of lies and everyone has their own reasons for using them.

Protagonist Souichirou has the strange ability to see through those lies, though he can’t see the reason behind it. Naturally this power comes at a cost and he even comes to be known as the number one problem child at his school.

Souichirou’s story takes a turn when a new spring arrives and he is called out by one of the most popular girls in school, Himeno Satsuki. The difference between them is immense and yet she timidly tells him that she likes him, raising the curtain for a love story between the school’s number one problem child and the school’s most beautiful girl.

[From [url=http://www.otakulair.com/news/japanese-visual-novels/new-brand-campus-opens-website-for-debut-game-haru-uso-passing-memories/]Otaku Lair[/url]]

This is the first of four low-priced games by Campus, a new brand affiliated with light. 

Each game in the series focuses on one of the four heroines, starting with Satsuki. As Souichirou, you, the player, is able to see others’ lies in pink stylized text. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
人们彼此说谎，总有各自的理由。他们可能为了保护自己、否认自己、欺骗自己，或者为了继续前行。谎言有各种各样，每个人使用谎言的原因也都不同。

主人公宗一郎拥有看穿谎言的奇妙能力，却无法看见谎言背后的理由。这个能力自然也有代价，他甚至因此成了学校里公认的头号问题学生。

春天再次到来，宗一郎的故事发生了转折。学校里最受欢迎的女生之一姬野五月把他叫了出去。两人之间的差距如此巨大，她却害羞地告诉宗一郎自己喜欢他。学校头号问题学生与学校最美少女之间的恋爱故事，就此拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=http://www.otakulair.com/news/japanese-visual-novels/new-brand-campus-opens-website-for-debut-game-haru-uso-passing-memories/]Otaku Lair[/url]]

这是新品牌Campus的四部低价作品中的第一部，该品牌隶属于light。

系列中的每部作品都聚焦四位女主角中的一位，第一部从五月开始。玩家以宗一郎的身份进行游戏，可以看到其他人用粉色特殊文字显示的谎言。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/11/26/november-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
